  fleet
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Usage: fleet [-h] [--version] COMMAND ...

Manage enrolled machines. A profile saves each machine’s choices.

positional arguments:
  COMMAND
    addons     List installed add-ons, optional manager extensions.
    backup     Copy managed files and the profile into a new private backup.
    backups    List backup folders with their dates, recorded results, and
               sizes.
    check      Check fetches new update results; status only reads the saved
               results.
    configure  Reopen the enrollment wizard.
    content    Show the content checkout, a local Git copy.
    diff       Show pending file paths and unified patches from chezmoi.
    doctor     Check profile completeness, drift, clean checkouts, and
               backups.
    domain     Show domains, or apply a named domain.
    groups     List optional content groups.
    help       Show commands and actions.
    machines   Show recorded machine facts from registry.toml.
    pins       List exact tool versions and installed state.
    profile    Show saved domain, identity, pins, groups, and agents from
               profile.toml.
    rollback   List backups or restore one after confirmation.
    secrets    Show secret variable names declared by the content manifest,
               the repository’s settings file.
    status     Status reads saved update results without fetching; check
               fetches new results.
    topology   Show this machine’s recorded view as a tree.
    tui        Open the terminal interface, a full-screen view of Fleet
               commands.
    uninstall  Remove the manager and its managed files after typed
               confirmation.
    update     Pull the manager and content repositories, then apply your
               saved choices.
    version    Show the manager version and content commit.

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --version    show program's version number and exit

Exit codes: 0 success, help, or cancellation; 1 failed operation or check; 2
invalid arguments or check failure; 130 interrupted. Check uses 1 for
available updates.
Examples: fleet update; fleet status; fleet domain set --name personal.
First install or manager recovery: use the README one-line installer.
Profile: saved machine choices. Pins: exact tool versions. Groups: optional
content.
Domain: content additions. Drift: differences in managed files.
Commit: saved Git version. Checkout: a local Git copy.
